pokeefnpc.npc.title: %s the %s
pokeefnpc.talk.villager: Just trying to get by. The fields don't work themselves.
pokeefnpc.talk.farmer: Good soil this year, if the rain holds.
pokeefnpc.talk.shepherd: The flock knows me better than the neighbours do.
pokeefnpc.talk.fisherman: Water's cold, the catch is honest.
pokeefnpc.talk.lumberjack: Every wall in this village came off my axe.
pokeefnpc.talk.miner: Down there it's dark and quiet. I prefer it.
pokeefnpc.talk.builder: Show me the gap and I'll close it before nightfall.
pokeefnpc.talk.tailor: Bring it torn, take it whole.
pokeefnpc.talk.innkeeper: Bed, bread and a fire. That's the whole offer.
pokeefnpc.talk.beggar: A coin, friend? I'll remember you for it.
pokeefnpc.talk.soldier: I hold this line because somebody has to.
pokeefnpc.talk.guard: Keep your hands where I can see them.
pokeefnpc.talk.night_watch: Nothing good comes out of that dark. Nothing.
pokeefnpc.talk.captain: The walls hold while I say they hold.
pokeefnpc.talk.knight: My oath is to this place and the people in it.
pokeefnpc.talk.archer: I'll see them coming long before you do.
pokeefnpc.talk.mercenary: My sword is for hire. My loyalty costs extra.
pokeefnpc.talk.hunter: The forest tells you things, if you shut up and listen.
pokeefnpc.talk.executioner: People cross the street when they see me. Sensible of them.
pokeefnpc.talk.traveller: I've walked further than this village has ever looked.
pokeefnpc.talk.adventurer: Got a contract? I've got a sword and a bad idea.
pokeefnpc.talk.adventurer_chief: I decide who takes the dangerous work, and who comes back.
pokeefnpc.talk.guild_clerk: Name, rank, and what you're here for. In that order.
pokeefnpc.talk.guild_master: The guild remembers everything. Including you.
pokeefnpc.talk.merchant: Everything has a price. Yours is negotiable.
pokeefnpc.talk.blacksmith: Steel doesn't lie. Bring me something worth mending.
pokeefnpc.talk.alchemist: Don't touch the green one. I mean it.
pokeefnpc.talk.banker: Coin kept here is coin you still have tomorrow.
pokeefnpc.talk.scribe: Say it slowly. I write everything down.
pokeefnpc.talk.mage: Power is mostly patience. The rest is arithmetic.
pokeefnpc.talk.priest: Sit. Whatever it is, it will keep for a moment.
pokeefnpc.talk.healer: Let me see it. Don't tell me it's fine.
pokeefnpc.talk.seer: I saw you coming. I usually do.
pokeefnpc.talk.bard: Every village thinks it has no story. Every village is wrong.
pokeefnpc.talk.thief: Keep your purse where I can't reach it. Friendly advice.
pokeefnpc.talk.smuggler: Ask no questions and the price stays low.
pokeefnpc.talk.black_market_dealer: The shelf is for strangers. The real stock is for friends.
pokeefnpc.talk.bandit: You're a long way from anyone who'd help you.
pokeefnpc.talk.noble: Speak plainly. My time is expensive.
pokeefnpc.talk.elder: I have buried more of this village than I have raised.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.refuse: I have nothing to say to you.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.nothing_to_sell: You have none of those to sell.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.shop_broke: I have no coin left today.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.rank_too_low: That work is above your standing.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.quest_accepted: Good. Don't make me regret it.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.quest_complete: Well done. Your pay, as agreed.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.quest_incomplete: You haven't finished. Come back when you have.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.wrong_recipient: I'm not the one waiting on that.
pokeefnpc.guild.top_rank: You can rise no higher here.
pokeefnpc.service.repair.description: Hand over what's in your main hand and I'll make it whole. Price follows the damage.
pokeefnpc.service.heal.description: Sit down. I'll close what's open and draw out what shouldn't be there.
pokeefnpc.service.rest.description: A meal, a bed, and this village will be where you wake if the worst happens.
pokeefnpc.settlement.none: This one belongs to no settlement.
pokeefnpc.editor.no_settlement: No settlement near enough to mark.
pokeefnpc.editor.wrong_mode: That mode does not mark blocks.
pokeefnpc.editor.tooltip.help: Right click air to change mode - sneak + right click an NPC to change role
pokeefnpc.dialogue.no_answer: Hm. I have nothing to say to that.
pokeefnpc.tooltip.soldier_egg: Place a soldier sworn to you, or offer the commission to an NPC that trusts you.
pokeefnpc.tooltip.soldier_egg_orders: Sneak + right-click a soldier of yours to change its orders.
pokeefnpc.stance.off_duty: As you wish. I'll get back to my own work.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.gear_worse: I've better than that already, but thank you.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.enlist_refused: I don't know you well enough to take up arms for you.
pokeefnpc.dialogue.enlist_accepted: Then I'll fight for you. Say the word.
